Thanks for the demo last week — the product looks promising. Our security and procurement teams would like to run a short orientation and collect CAIQ/SIG answers and a small set of log samples so we can complete our review.

- Sample logs and a minimal runbook for accessing them in a demo environment

Would any of these windows work for you or your security lead?
- Tue 5/19 10:00-10:45 PDT
- Wed 5/20 14:00-14:45 PDT

Also, do you have an intake spreadsheet or template we can fill out ahead of time, and any examples of the logs you typically provide?

Thanks,

- Kimberly: produce the 2-3 slide bullets + pointer to our runbook for log sampling.

I’ll own scheduling and the calendar invite.

Ben
